mainEntity.name: What is a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP)?

acceptedAnswer.text: An MSSP delivers outsourced cybersecurity services including 24/7 SOC monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management, acting as an extension of your internal security team.

mainEntity.name: Does ISECURION MSSP support compliance requirements globally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISECURION MSSP supports compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, RBI guidelines (India), GDPR (EU/UK), MAS TRM (Singapore), DORA (EU), and SAMA/NCA frameworks (GCC/UAE).

mainEntity.name: Which industries benefit most from MSSP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financial services, healthcare, e-commerce, IT/SaaS, manufacturing, government, and telecom sectors benefit greatly from continuous MSSP coverage.

mainEntity.name: Can ISECURION MSSP serve global organizations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISECURION delivers MSSP services to enterprises across India (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune), USA, UK, UAE, GCC, Singapore, and Australia.

mainEntity.name: How does MSSP detect and respond to threats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through advanced SIEM platforms, AI-based behavioral analytics, threat intelligence feeds, EDR tools, and 24/7 monitoring by certified security analysts.

mainEntity.name: What is included in MSSP incident response?

acceptedAnswer.text: Detection, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, root cause analysis, and post-incident recommendations to prevent recurrence.

mainEntity.name: Can MSSP manage cloud security across AWS, Azure, and GCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISECURION MSSP monitors, detects, and remediates security issues across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments.

mainEntity.name: Is MSSP scalable for growing organizations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. MSSP services scale with your business - from SMEs to large enterprises - adapting to infrastructure growth and evolving threat landscapes.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can ISECURION respond to critical incidents?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION provides rapid response - typically within 15–30 minutes for critical incidents - with dedicated escalation paths and SLA-backed commitments.

mainEntity.name: How do you measure MSSP effectiveness?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through KPIs including mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to respond (MTTR), threat detection rate, system uptime, compliance posture, and monthly security reporting dashboards.

mainEntity.name: Can MSSP services be customized for our industry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISECURION tailors MSSP programs to your organization's industry, size, regulatory environment, risk profile, and existing IT infrastructure.

mainEntity.name: What tools are used in ISECURION's MSSP platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: We leverage enterprise-grade SIEM platforms, EDR/XDR solutions, threat intelligence feeds, network traffic analysis tools, SOAR automation, and proprietary analytics.

mainEntity.name: How does MSSP integrate with my existing security tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION MSSP integrates with your existing firewalls, endpoint tools, identity systems, and ticketing platforms - working alongside your IT/security team without disruption.

mainEntity.name: Can MSSP reduce our overall cybersecurity spend?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Outsourcing 24/7 SOC operations eliminates the cost of hiring, training, and retaining an in-house security team, significantly reducing total security spend while increasing coverage.
Yes. ISECURION is CERT-In empanelled and ISO 27001:2022 certified, ensuring our MSSP services meet India's highest cybersecurity standards.
